info.name: JALIKUD API
info.description:
JALIKUD Laravel + Sanctum REST API.

== THINK ABOUT ADMIN AUTH ==
The /api/admin/* endpoints require a user whose role = admin. Register/Login create NORMAL users (role = 'customer'), so they will get 403 on admin-only calls. The Admin folder starts with 'Login (as Admin)' which authenticates with admin_username / admin_password (you must supply these in the environment) and stores a SEPARATE admin_token used by all admin requests.

== DYNAMIC, REPEATABLE TEST INPUT ==
Write requests use AUTO-GENERATED inputs from pre-request scripts. Variables prefixed input_* (user) or admin_* (admin) change every run, so you can re-run without deleting rows.

The ONE input you must set yourself: admin_username + admin_password (an existing user whose role = admin).

== NEW SCHEMA (2026-09-15) ==
Users: phone, role enum (customer|staff|admin|rider), SoftDeletes
Catalog: categories (parent_id hierarchical), menu_items (base_price, is_available, is_featured, preparation_time_minutes, calories), variant_groups + variant_options
Commerce: carts (order_type: delivery|pickup), cart_items (unit_price snapshot, notes), cart_item_options
Orders: order_type (delivery|pickup), order_number, status enum, totals (subtotal/discount/delivery_fee/tax/total), scheduled_for, placed_at
Coupons: fixed|percentage, usage_limit, starts_at/expires_at, is_active
Store: store_settings (store_name, is_open, accepts_delivery, accepts_pickup, delivery_fee, tax_rate_percent, opening_time, closing_time)

Flow: Auth -> My Account -> Admin Login -> Admin CRUD -> Catalog -> Cart -> Orders -> Teardown.
